source: AI-generated full-scene Journey background for the Ruined Temple section.
coordinateNote: Runtime composited 16:9 backdrop; legacy region keys point to the full image so existing loaders stay fallback-safe. The non-destructive temple mask grade keeps this combined image as the source of truth: the renderer draws a cooler cliff/sky base grade, then redraws the same image through a polygon or optional transparent mask to keep the temple and necropolis ruins warmer.

templeNecropolis.note: Optional transparent PNG mask. White/opaque pixels define the temple and necropolis ruins area. If missing, the renderer falls back to polygonMasks.templeNecropolis.

sourceComposite: Generated as a full 16:9 scene so gameplay no longer relies on source-sheet strips.
